cards.card_text: The older sister is named Oholah, and her sister is named Oholibah.
cards.verse_text: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah.
cards.snippet: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah.

cards.card_text: Oholibah, her sister, stands for the city where the kings of Judah reigned (1 Kings 14:21): the city of ___.
cards.verse_text: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah.
cards.snippet: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah.

cards.card_text: Oholibah saw everything that happened to her sister.
cards.verse_text: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.
cards.snippet: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved…

cards.card_text: After seeing what happened to Oholah, what does Oholibah do?
cards.verse_text: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.
cards.snippet: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved…

cards.card_text: But Oholibah goes further: she sees men engraved on a wall in vermilion, with belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads.
cards.verse_text: But Oholibah carried her prostitution even further.
cards.snippet: But Oholibah carried her prostitution even further.

cards.card_text: When Oholibah openly prostitutes herself, God turns away from her just as He did from her sister.
cards.verse_text: When Oholibah openly prostituted herself and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.
cards.snippet: When Oholibah openly prostituted herself and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her…

cards.card_text: Now the Lord GOD speaks straight to Oholibah.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will incite your lovers against you, those from whom you turned away in disgust.
cards.snippet: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will incite your lovers…

cards.card_text: God says Oholibah's lovers will come against her from only one side.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will incite your lovers against you, those from whom you turned away in disgust.
cards.snippet: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will incite your lovers…

cards.card_text: God has been picturing Samaria and Jerusalem as two sisters, Oholah and Oholibah, who became His but were unfaithful to Him (Ezekiel 23:4-5, 11).
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah?
cards.snippet: …to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah?

cards.card_text: God tells Ezekiel to declare to Oholah and Oholibah their abominations.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah?
cards.snippet: …to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah?

cards.card_text: And the men slept with Oholah and Oholibah as with a prostitute.
cards.verse_text: And they slept with her as with a prostitute; they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, those lewd women.
cards.snippet: …slept with her as with a prostitute; they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, those lewd women.
